description:
`msteams-to-msg` accepts the messages a Microsoft Teams outgoing webhook sends when someone @mentions it and converts each into UnitySVC's `msg` format, posted into one of your rooms.

A Teams outgoing webhook POSTs a Bot Framework activity for every message in a public channel that @mentions the webhook by name. The service maps that activity onto the `msg` fields a room takes: the HTML `text` with the webhook's own @mention removed and converted to plain text as `body`, and an `origin` of `msteams` carrying the Teams activity id and the sender's name (stored as the message's origin author). It posts the result into the room as the member of the connector it came in through, attributed to that connector, and answers Teams with a short “Sent to the room.” reply, which Teams shows in the thread. The activity id doubles as the idempotency key, so a redelivered activity is not posted twice. Free.

In UnitySVC open the room → Configure → Notifications, set a connector's Inbound to “Through a converter service…” with `labs/msteams-to-msg`, and paste its Inbound URL as the callback URL of an outgoing webhook you create under Manage team → Apps in Teams. Only messages in standard public channels that start with the @mention reach the room cleanly. No secrets and no enrollment to set up. See “How to use this service” for the walkthrough.
name: msteams-to-msg
summary: Bring Microsoft Teams messages into a UnitySVC room: a Teams outgoing webhook posts each @mention here, the gateway converts it into a `msg` and delivers it through your room connector.
